tweets.content:
The pricing experiment that doubled Mira's revenue:

We raised monthly sub from $9.99 → $14.99 on March 1.

Expected: Fewer subs, higher ARPU
Result: BOTH went up

March 1-15: $8,247 (vs Feb's $6,891 total)

Lesson: Underpricing signals 'low value.' Your fans will pay more than you think — if you ask.

Variety sounds smart. Consistency builds trust.

Fans recognize the look. That's the point.
